text:
julia: Quick kickoff — Polaris lab access handshake. NDA signed Fri, Polaris confirmed rack access for their silicon next month. Goal: 1-week bench sprint + telemetry feed for quality feedback and a joint marketplace packaging plan. Need owners for lab creds, bench image, telemetry schema, and marketing embargo. TL;DR: sync this week and start run prep.

sam: I can take the bench harness and runbook. Will need a validated model bundle (weights + config) and perf targets. Is Polaris providing a reference runtime or should we use our compiled runtime?

marco: I’ll coordinate test vectors and expected baselines. We should lock sequence lengths and mixed-precision settings up front. Proposal: {128,512,2048} seq + int8/float16 sweep. Also want to capture tail latency percentiles.

anya: Legal confirms NDA covers telemetry as long as data is anonymized and we delete raw logs within 30 days. We need Polaris to sign the handback + deletion appendix before any raw traces leave their lab.

julia: @anya noted. I'll push the appendix and flag it in the Polaris thread.

devops-bot: deploy: lab-snapshot-ignite-2026-03 created by infra-team. Image tag: ignite-2026-03a.

sam: Good — I'll base runs on ignite-2026-03a. Can someone add Polaris SSH keys to the access list? Need username mapping and key owner.

liz: I can own the keys onboarding. @sam send me the username mapping and I'll coordinate with infra and Polaris ops.

tarek: On the marketplace side, we need to decide packaging surface: a prebuilt container + a small README + a performance card. Marketing embargo window: target joint announcement 2 weeks after sprint ends. That means we must be ready to sign off on perf claims 3 days after the sprint.

marco: For signoff, let's run an end-to-end reproducibility check: same seed, same input corpus, record GPU config and driver. I'll write a reproducibility checklist in the runbook.

sam: Example quick run command I plan to share with Polaris engineers:
```
./run_bench --model polaris-xl --image ignite-2026-03a --seq 2048 --precision int8 --runs 10 --telemetry-endpoint https://telemetry.redwood.internal/collect
```

julia: Action items: 1) @sam bench harness + runbook due Tue 3/23; 2) @liz onboard keys by Wed 3/24; 3) @marco reproducibility checklist by Wed 3/24; 4) @anya finalize handback appendix by Mon 3/22. Polaris contact is emma@polaris.ai — I've looped her in on email.

anya: Confirmed timeline. I'll also add a short clause about redaction of model outputs in the appendix.

devops-bot: reminder: scheduled maintenance in lab on 2026-03-26 from 02:00-04:00 UTC — may affect long runs.

sam: Noted — will avoid long runs during maintenance window. Short runs for smoke tests only then.

tarek: One more ask from biz: want a short 1-slide perf summary template we can fill for the joint announcement. @marco can you draft after the sprint?

marco: Yup — will draft template and share as part of runbook artifacts.

julia: Great. I'll schedule a 30m sync with Polaris ops + our infra for Fri 3/19 9am PT. If that works for everyone, I'll send a calendar invite and include the runbook link once initial draft exists. :thumbsup:

liz: Works for me.

sam: Works. I'll attach initial harness repo link in thread before the sync.

julia: Thanks team — keeping this thread for progress updates. Please post short status lines here so we can have a single source of truth. :eyes:
